title: My Small Flat
text:
I live in a small flat in the city. It has a living room, a bedroom, a kitchen, and a bathroom. In the living room there is a big sofa and a table. My bed is in the bedroom.

The kitchen has a fridge and a stove. I like my flat because it is warm and quiet. My cat sleeps on a chair near the window. There is also a lamp next to my bed.

questions.text: What is in the living room?
options: A big sofa and a table

questions.text: What can we infer about the narrator's cat?
options: It feels comfortable by the window
It does not like the flat

questions.text: Where does the narrator probably read at night?
options: In bed, next to the lamp
In the kitchen, on the stove
In the bathroom, near the sink

paragraph_translations: Я живу в маленькій квартирі в місті. У ній є вітальня, спальня, кухня та ванна кімната. У вітальні є великий диван і стіл. Моє ліжко стоїть у спальні.
На кухні є холодильник і плита. Мені подобається моя квартира, бо в ній тепло і тихо. Мій кіт спить на стільці біля вікна. Поруч з моїм ліжком також є лампа.
